variant_policy: Parameter choices, alternative quantiles, constant rescalings, and monotone transforms are listed as variants and do not inflate the family count.

metrics.formula: Aggregate the elapsed years between focal publication and first prior appearance of each controlled concept; shorter history indicates greater novelty.
metrics.notes: Requires a cross-domain controlled-concept history not frozen locally.

metrics.formula: Aggregate the number of strictly prior articles containing each controlled concept; lower prior volume indicates greater novelty.
metrics.notes: Requires a controlled vocabulary and complete prior usage history.

metrics.formula: Number of focal knowledge components never observed in the relevant prior corpus divided by the number of focal components.
metrics.notes: The local data do not contain a source-faithful cross-domain keyword/entity history.

metrics.formula: Share of focal words or n-grams absent from a frozen burn-in vocabulary and all strictly prior documents.
metrics.notes: Sensitive to spelling and synonyms; Shibayama et al. report weak overall survey correlations for a new-word dummy.

metrics.selected_variant: 10th percentile cosine distance to strictly prior documents
metrics.formula: Q0.10_j[1-cosine(embedding(focal), embedding(prior_j))] over strictly prior documents.
metrics.notes: Validated against an author survey, but the required historically frozen cross-domain embedding space is not available locally.

metrics.formula: Local Outlier Factor of a focal document in a source-defined historical semantic vector space.
metrics.notes: Needs frozen text, embedding, neighborhood size, and comparison universe.

metrics.label_zh: 语义网络知识单元原创性
metrics.formula: Source-defined aggregation of novelty of knowledge units and their positions or links in a historical semantic network.
metrics.notes: Required text-derived knowledge units and semantic network are not frozen locally.

metrics.formula: Identify textual ideas absent from strictly prior publications and aggregate their focal-paper origin strength.
metrics.notes: Only the origin component is T0; later reuse and impact components remain outcomes.

metrics.formula: Source-defined cloud-model aggregation of focal topic features and topic reorganization novelty.
metrics.notes: Requires a source-faithful, time-bounded topic model and cloud parameters.

metrics.formula: Mean_t[-log P_historical_model(token_t | token_<t)] or a source-defined semantic-representation gain.
metrics.notes: No historically bounded model series is frozen for the target corpus.

metrics.label_zh: 人类—大模型协同新颖性判断
metrics.formula: Source-defined aggregation of human knowledge and LLM novelty judgments.
metrics.notes: Not deterministic without a frozen model, prompts, retrieval corpus, annotators, and aggregation protocol.

metrics.label_zh: Novelty U 组合常见度下尾
metrics.selected_variant: negative log 10th-percentile commonness with frozen zero rule
metrics.formula: -ln(Q0.10[(O_ij+zero_rule)N/(N_i N_j)]) over focal cited-source pairs.
metrics.notes: Conceptual evidence is meaningful, but this local implementation misses both frozen stability thresholds.

metrics.formula: -Q0.10[(O_ij-E_ij)/sqrt(Var_ij)] over focal cited-source pairs under a fixed-marginal hypergeometric null.
metrics.notes: The analytical null is explicitly an adaptation; the local tail statistic fails both stability gates.

metrics.formula: Q0.50[(O_ij-E_ij)/sqrt(Var_ij)] over focal cited-source pairs under a fixed-marginal hypergeometric null.
metrics.notes: This is the conventional backbone companion in the Uzzi profile, not a standalone novelty signal.

metrics.formula: Number of focal unordered cited-source pairs absent from all strictly prior papers divided by the number of valid focal pairs.
metrics.notes: Mixed validation is retained transparently; the scale-free share variant passes all prespecified local gates.

metrics.formula: Mean historical cognitive distance among focal cited-source pairs that have never co-occurred before.
metrics.notes: Fails coverage catastrophically in the current data.

metrics.label_zh: 参考文献集合重叠新颖性
metrics.formula: 1 - mean_j |R_focal ∩ R_j| / |R_focal ∪ R_j| over strictly prior same-field comparison papers sharing at least one reference.
metrics.notes: Passes every frozen gate; corpus and taxonomy adaptations are explicit.

metrics.label_zh: 被引文献语义重组距离
metrics.selected_variant: maximum cosine distance among cited-reference text embeddings
metrics.formula: max_{j,k in references}[1-cosine(embedding(j), embedding(k))].
metrics.notes: Strong conceptual candidate, but cited-reference text and a frozen cross-domain embedding model are unavailable.

metrics.formula: Aggregate elapsed years since the first prior occurrence of each focal controlled-concept pair.
metrics.notes: No cross-domain controlled-concept pair history is frozen locally.

metrics.label_zh: 概念组合使用量新颖性
metrics.formula: Aggregate inverse strictly prior article counts for focal controlled-concept pairs.
metrics.notes: No cross-domain controlled-concept pair history is frozen locally.

metrics.label_zh: 问题—方法生命指数新颖性
metrics.formula: Source-defined combination of age and accumulated frequency for extracted question terms, method terms, and their pairs.
metrics.notes: Requires validated question/method extraction across all target domains.

metrics.label_zh: 问题—方法语义组合新颖性
metrics.formula: Source-defined semantic distance of extracted focal question-method combinations from historical combinations.
metrics.notes: No frozen extraction model or historical semantic space is available locally.

metrics.label_zh: 研究内容—情境组合惊异度
metrics.formula: Surprise of observed content-context association relative to a historically fitted expectation model.
metrics.notes: Requires frozen content and researcher-context representations.

metrics.formula: Aggregate historical rarity or first occurrence of focal topic pairs under a frozen topic model.
metrics.notes: Requires a historically fitted topic model and complete text history.

metrics.formula: Aggregate negative predicted probabilities or unexpectedness of focal knowledge-unit links under a strictly prior network.
metrics.notes: No source-faithful historical semantic or knowledge network is frozen locally.

metrics.label_zh: 历史知识社群桥接策略
metrics.formula: Share of focal knowledge links connecting different communities in a strictly prior knowledge network.
metrics.notes: A strategy/context construct, not automatically a direct novelty measure.

metrics.formula: Mean over focal cited-source pairs of 1[prior pair count <= k], with k fixed by the project.
metrics.notes: Empirically stable but the thresholded paper-level formula is a project choice, not the cited source's exact indicator.

metrics.label_zh: 知识源组合平均惊异度
metrics.formula: Mean[-ln((O_ij+zero_rule)N/(N_i N_j))] over focal cited-source pairs.
metrics.notes: It is not Novelty U and has no peer-reviewed original or exact paper-level application.

metrics.formula: Binary or ordinal human coding that a paper introduces a new method.
metrics.notes: Useful validation label, but not an automatically computable indicator in the current corpus.

metrics.label_zh: 新理论或解释贡献标签
metrics.formula: Binary or ordinal human coding that a paper introduces a new theory or explanation.
metrics.notes: Contribution-locus label, not a reference-only metric.

metrics.label_zh: 新结果或发现贡献标签
metrics.formula: Binary or ordinal human coding that a paper reports a new result or discovery.
metrics.notes: Contribution-locus label, not a reference-only metric.

metrics.label_zh: 新问题或假设贡献标签
metrics.formula: Binary or ordinal human coding that a paper poses a new question, problem, or hypothesis.
metrics.notes: Contribution-locus label, not a reference-only metric.

metrics.formula: Number of distinct fields represented by valid focal references.
metrics.notes: A valid diversity component, deliberately excluded from direct novelty.

metrics.formula: 1 - Gini(reference-field shares).
metrics.notes: A diversity component, not direct evidence that anything is new.

metrics.formula: Mean_{k<l occupied}[1-cosine(historical_profile_k, historical_profile_l)].
metrics.notes: Cognitive disparity belongs to diversity/interdisciplinarity unless historical newness is separately established.

metrics.formula: Sum_{k,l} p_k p_l d_kl.
metrics.notes: A strong diversity/integration measure but not a direct novelty indicator.

metrics.formula: Number of valid focal references outside the focal paper's primary field divided by valid focal references.
metrics.notes: Measures breadth relative to a focal field, not historical newness.

metrics.formula: Source-defined linkage-strength and path-length statistics among focal knowledge elements.
metrics.notes: Interdisciplinarity/coherence construct and not frozen locally.

metrics.formula: Relative variety multiplied by balance multiplied by mean disparity.
metrics.notes: A composite interdisciplinarity measure, not novelty.

metrics.formula: Future-citation-network contrast between later papers citing the focal paper, its references, or both.
metrics.notes: Explicitly excluded because it is a post-publication outcome.

metrics.label_zh: 后续复用确认的首次组合
metrics.formula: Share of focal first-time pairs that are reused by later publications.
metrics.notes: A later confirmation or impact signal, not publication-time novelty.
